correctness.rationale: For correlated standard Gaussian adjacent pair (Z0,Z1), p=P(Z0Z1<0)=acos(rho)/pi and direct conditional-normal integration by parts yields E[Z0^2 I]=p-rho sqrt(1-rho^2)/pi. After multiplying sigma^2, endpoint covariance follows. Gaussian AR1 Markov property gives E[X_j^2-sigma^2|X_i]=rho^(2(i-j))(X_i^2-sigma^2) for j<=i and time-reverse analog to right, yielding local kernel. For edge i, j-site kernel sums two finite geometric series; summing i gives claimed closed covariance and opposite sign. Independent scipy high-tolerance Gaussian integrals for rho=-.8,-.4,0,.4,.8 and finite n=2,5,11 edge sums agreed; analytic proof covers all n and |rho|<1.

value.rationale: Crossing count and quadratic energy are canonical complementary sign-activity and amplitude summaries.
